testCases.title: Administrator can create org/team/app/user
steps: Confirm the New Organization / New Team / New Application / New User actions are available and functional
expectedResults: Administrator has full create/edit across the core entities

testCases.title: End user has read-only access and cannot edit records

preconditions.state: Logged in as a viewer-level user

steps: Confirm no create/edit/delete controls are available
expectedResults: User (viewer) can read records but sees no create/edit/delete controls
assertions: Edit/Delete/New controls are not visible for TU-004

testCases.title: Manager Tasks page is visible only to managers
steps: Confirm the Manager Tasks page is not shown
Confirm the Manager Tasks page is shown
expectedResults: Manager Tasks page hidden for non-managers (isUserMemberOfGroup on UAM managers), shown for managers
assertions: TU-004 cannot see or reach the manager-tasks page; TU-003 can

testCases.title: Access Status column shows Granted/Not Granted only to managers
steps: Open a screen embedding the team grid (UAM_gridlayout_TeamNamesOnly) with orgid/teamid context
Confirm the Access Status tag renders Granted or Not Granted per team
Log in as TU-004 and confirm the Access Status column is not shown
expectedResults: Access Status column is visible only to managers and reflects the user's team-group membership
assertions: Column visible for TU-003, hidden for TU-004
